This plot is small, only 0.07 hectares, so I must make every bit of land count. I will use the hybrid maize seed I got from the agro-dealer because it gives better yield than local seed, and I will put both manure from my livestock and a little bit of chemical fertilizer—whatever I can afford from the subsidy program—to help the crop grow. I cannot afford pesticides or herbicides, so my children and I will pull the weeds by hand, and we will rely on the rains because there is no money for irrigation. Since the plot is not big, my family can manage all the work ourselves without hiring anyone.
